content_of_post_to_answer: How did you start seeing your mental health challenges as strengths rather than weaknesses, and what advice would you give to someone struggling with this perspective?
answer: I started seeing my mental health challenges differently when I stopped asking, “What is wrong with me?” and started asking, “What has this taught me about myself?” Struggles can develop awareness, empathy, and emotional precision, but they are not valuable because they hurt; they are valuable because of what we learn while responding to them. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. A challenge does not become a strength by being romanticized; it becomes one when it expands your understanding of yourself.
